import pandas as pd

# Get season 6 daily class performance
s6 = tables['trips'][tables['trips']['fished_date_season'] == 6].copy()

# Calculate per-class-day metrics
daily = s6.groupby(['fished_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
}).reset_index()
daily['yt_per_angler'] = daily['yt'] / daily['anglers']

# Pivot to see all classes per day
pivot = daily.pivot(index='fished_date_doy', columns='cls', values='yt_per_angler')

# Look for two-day triggers (both yesterday and today > 0.25)
overnight = pivot.get('overnight', pd.Series())
day_1_5 = pivot.get('day_1_5', pd.Series())

print("=== Season 6 Daily Performance ===")
print(pivot.fillna('-').to_string())
print("\n=== Checking for OVERNIGHT two-day triggers (>0.25) ===")
for i in range(1, len(overnight)):
    prev_ov = overnight.iloc[i-1]
    curr_ov = overnight.iloc[i]
    doy_prev = overnight.index[i-1]
    doy_curr = overnight.index[i]
    if pd.notna(prev_ov) and pd.notna(curr_ov) and prev_ov > 0.25 and curr_ov > 0.25:
        print(f"Trigger at d{doy_curr}: d{doy_prev} ({prev_ov:.3f}) + d{doy_curr} ({curr_ov:.3f})")

print("\n=== Checking for DAY_1_5 two-day triggers (>0.25) ===")
for i in range(1, len(day_1_5)):
    prev_d1p5 = day_1_5.iloc[i-1]
    curr_d1p5 = day_1_5.iloc[i]
    doy_prev = day_1_5.index[i-1]
    doy_curr = day_1_5.index[i]
    if pd.notna(prev_d1p5) and pd.notna(curr_d1p5) and prev_d1p5 > 0.25 and curr_d1p5 > 0.25:
